dates.text: dexto bailli octobris, anno a nativitate domini millesimo qua dediger teston quadragesimo

data.summary: Pope Felix V grants the prepositus and canons of the Monastery of St. Leonard in Basel permission to wear specific vestments (vario grises and asperiolis) in processions, overriding previous privileges of the Cathedral Chapter.
